Question: Joey and his five brothers are ages \(3,\) \(5,\) \(7,\) \(9,\) \(11,\) and \(13.\) One afternoon two of his brothers whose ages sum to \(16\) went to the movies, two brothers younger than \(10\) went to play baseball, and Joey and the \(5\)-year-old stayed home. How old is Joey?
